violation_type.title: Medication Records - Name of Medication (26 TAC §746.3805(c)(2))
violation_type.typical_finding: During the course of the investigation, medication was given to a child, and the information was not recorded on an administration form.

finding_variants.text: During the course of the investigation, medication was given to a child, and the information was not recorded on an administration form.

The medication log was missing the name of medication that was administered to a child in care. The name of medication was listed as pain medication.    Note: The provider found the medication that was given and documented it on the medication log during the inspection.
Completed medication administration logs have not been shared by the operation with CCR.
The name of medication administered to a child was not documented on the medication log.    Note: The provider added the name of the medication during inspection.
There was no documentation of the name of the medication that was administered to a child.
One child with prescription medication to be given daily has no documentation when the medication has been administered thus far.
